questions.question: After King Solomon finished praying at the new temple, what came down from heaven and consumed the offerings?
After fire from heaven consumed the offerings at Solomon's new temple, what did the glory of the LORD do to the temple?
When the Israelites saw fire fall from heaven and God's glory above Solomon's temple, what did they do?

answers.text: Bowed with their faces to the ground
Ran back toward the city gates
Stood still and covered their eyes
